csv_project_name: Design service for Upper Darby New Community Center
csv_scope_of_work: Upper Darby Township is soliciting proposals from qualified professional consultants to provide comprehensive architectural design services for the development of a new Community Center at the Beverly Hills Recreation Area within Upper Darby Township, Delaware County, PA. The selected consultant shall be responsible for preparing detailed design and construction drawings and technical specifications for the new Community Center, which will be incorporated by Upper Darby Township with the Civil plans into a complete construction bid package for the overall Community Center construction at the Beverly Hills Recreation Area.
